Standard Organization of Nigeria

PHL

International law

______ can be defined as any failure of the accused to exercise reasonable care that has resulted in the injury of another or has caused or capable of causing threat to the health and safety of another.

______ are those one possesses as a citizen; human rights are possessed by virtue of being human.
Civil rights

______ are the laws made by the National Assembly (the Senate and the House of Representatives) and they have national effect if they border on matters within the exclusive and concurrent legislative list.
Acts of the National Assembly

Acts of the National Assembly are the laws made by the National Assembly (the Senate and the House of Representatives) and they have national effect if they border on matters within the exclusive and concurrent legislative list.
______ is the process by which a law is made by a legislative body or a body empowered by law to make laws.
law making process
Law making or law making process is the process by which a law is made by a legislative body or a body empowered by law to make laws.

______ is that which affect or that is capable of affecting the general public which is actionable at the instance of the Attorney General of the State.
